title: amphicarpaea edgeworthii var. trisperma
intro: Amphicarpaea edgeworthii var. trisperma, commonly known as the "two-fruited horse bean", is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its use as a natural remedy for various ailments, due to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate pain, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Amphicarpaea edgeworthii var. trisperma include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
